<thought>We need to find the template that, when applied to the target molecule (the sulfonamide product), yields the precursors [Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1, c3ccccc3N]. The transformation is the formation of a sulfonamide (S–N bond). Therefore we search the template catalog for templates that form a sulfonamide functional group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(N(S(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)c3ccccc3)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
